eROSITA-DE:DataRelease1:Catalogues_DR1 eRASS1 source catalogues This webpage offers the catalogues produced by the eROSITA-DE members. Each catalogue is described on detail in a data model page. As more catalogues are published, they will be listed here. ID Name Link to data model Link to latest catalogue Description Reference General catalogues 1 eROSITA/eRASS1 main catalogue eRASS1 Main catalogue model eRASS1 Main catalogue X-ray sources detected in the 0.2>2.3 keV band using eSASS adopting a detection likelihood threshold of 5. The sources with detection likelihood larger than 6 are selected as the main eRASS1 catalogue (930203 sources). 12.01.2026: Version 1.2 available. It fixes the values of the column named NO_FLAG_EXT_ERR . Merloni, A., et al.                         extended X-ray sources in a 13116 square degree region in the western Galactic hemisphere of the sky, which 
                        eROSITA surveyed in its first six months of operation. The clusters in the sample span the redshift range 
                        from 0.003 to 1.32.                         The clusters in the sample span the photometric redshift range from 0.1 to 0.8. This catalog is used
